All glomeruli show gloat, diffuse endocapillary and mesangial hypercellularity with neutrophils infiltrating through gloat, diffuse endocapillary and mesangial hypercellularity with neutrophils infiltrating through glomeruli. Diffuse endocapillary and mesangial hypercellularity with neutrophils infiltrating through glomeruli. There is moderate tubular atrophy and interstitial fibrosis involving approximately 30% of the cortex. No necrosis of rhodnised necrosis are seen.

### Immunofluorescence Description:
Immunofluorescence Description:  
IgG: 3+ granular staining in mesangium and capillary loops (full house pattern).  
IgA: 2+ granular staining in mesangium and capillary loops.  
C3: 3+ granular staining in mesangium and capillary loops.  
Cb1: 2+ granular staining in mesangium and capillary loops.  
Fibrinogen: Negative.  
Albumin: Negative.

### Electron Microscopy Description:
Electron microscopy demonstrates foot processes effectively, diffuse subendothelial and mesangial endothelium. Tubulointerstitial microscopy confirms diffuse subendothelial cells. There is approximately 50% podocyte foot processes effectacement.

### Comment:
The combined findings are diagnostic of active, diffuse global lupus nephritis. ISN/RPS 2003 Class IV-G (A).

Severe tricompartmental osteoarthritis most pronounced in the medial femoral condyle compartment with high-grade cartilage loss, subchondral cystic changes, and marginal osteophyte.

No acute fracture or ligamentous rupture identified.
